messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD-8932: prober 'prober-eu-1' consecutive failures (5/5). Probe group: synth-canaries/eu. Bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridges/rdw-3072 Pager link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-8932 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Incident created and escalated to on-call group 'sre-prod' -> assigned to devon.
alex: acked. jumping in to triage.
devon: taking this. quick check: prober shows HTTP 500s from the prober pod, not the target model endpoints. model endpoints show normal 2xx. suspect prober-side failure.
maria: are there any customer-facing errors? any API spikes?
devon: looking at fronting api metrics — no error-rate increase for customers. only synth/canary probe failures, so likely monitoring-only impact. still noisy, PD firing repeatedly.
kai: grabbing logs from the prober pod now. seeing repeated OOM kills on prober container -> kubelet reports OOMKilled for pod prober-eu-1-78bf. snippet:
```
Mar 21 15:02:21 prober-eu-1 kubelet: container prober terminated with exit code 137 (OOMKilled)
Mar 21 15:02:24 prober: ERROR runtime: out of memory allocating 64MB buffer
Mar 21 15:02:24 prober: stack: goroutine 215 [running]:
...
```
devon: that matches the probe process OOM. recent deploy to prober tagged `prober:canary-2027` rolled out ~2h ago. rolling back to previous stable tag should stop the noise.
maria: agree. we should also suppress PD for the probe group while we roll back so alerts don't re-flood. can someone add a temporary suppression window?
devon: adding PD suppression for synth-canaries/eu for 30m. also scaling prober replica to 0 to quiesce churn while we rollback.
commands I ran:
```bash
kubectl -n infra-scale scale deployment prober-eu --replicas=0  # drain prober pool
kubectl -n infra-scale set image deploy/prober-eu prober=registry.redwood/prober:v2.3.4  # rollback to last stable
```
kai: rollback applied, new pods starting with v2.3.4. watch shows no OOMs so far.
pagerduty: PD-8932 acknowledged by devon.
devon: I'm re-enabling probes in ~5m but with reduced fanout (throttle config) to confirm stability. patch applied to prober config: `fanout=0.2, timeout=5s`.
maria: good. i'll open a follow-up ticket to investigate memory regression in canary build (likely header caching change). tagging runtime / prober owners.
alex: please add a short blurb to #customer-impact if CS asks — say 'internal synth probes flapping, no customer-facing errors; investigation in progress'.
devon: created INC-4563: "prober canary memory regression" with logs and rollback steps. linking PD-8932 -> INC-4563.
kai: metrics look stable, no new OOMs for ~3m. re-enabling scale to 2 replicas slowly.
maria: i'll monitor for 30m then hand back to next oncall. alex, want to take post-incident remediation?
alex: yep i'll own the postmortem and follow-ups.
devon: removing PD suppression now that rollback is in place and probe fanout is throttled; will re-enable full probes only after 60m of green.
pagerduty: PD-8932 resolved by devon (manual resolution).
alex: thanks everyone. short postmortem later. customers unaffected, monitoring noise only. closing thread but keeping INC-4563 open for root-cause. :thumbsup:
